page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6e.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.85 GB per vCPU.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage must be network-attached. There are no integrated GPUs or hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput network operations.

Given its high vCPU count relative to memory, the ecs.c6e.26xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. It is suitable for high-performance computing (HPC), batch processing, intensive web serving, and compute-bound distributed analytics.
